phase1.explanation:
🦀 **Threads allow concurrent execution.**

**Thread operations:**

| Operation | Code |
|-----------|------|
| Spawn | `thread::spawn(|| { ... })` |
| Join | `handle.join()` |
| Sleep | `thread::sleep(duration)` |
| Current | `thread::current()` |

**Rust-chan says:**
"Threads are lightweight. Rust's borrow checker prevents data races."

**When to use threads:**
| Situation | Use threads |
|-----------|------------|
| Parallel work | ✅ |
| I/O operations | ✅ |
| CPU-intensive tasks | ✅ |
| Responsive UI | ✅ |
